title: Potato of Life — Deep Structure Additions
purpose: Promote high-value structures that were still trapped in book-research or prior project context into the canonical knowledge tree. This record preserves developmental strata and distinguishes project canon, book-derived doctrine, later interpretation and open inference.

provenance.primary_book_layer: The Great Book of Potato (2024), especially material already extracted into book-research.json
provenance.project_context_layer: Prior Potato of Life / Tim Dooley project development preserved in conversation-derived working context
provenance.rule: Do not treat later interpretations as if they were already fully formed in 2024. Preserve dated doctrinal development.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Chosen Vegetable
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The deliberate choice of the potato as a humble, ordinary and buried carrier of maximum existential and spiritual meaning.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Hierarchy Inversion
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The lowly, buried, overlooked or ridiculous thing becomes structurally foundational rather than marginal. Value is inverted: what appears least exalted can become the root beneath the system.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Seed Simplicity / Efficiency
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Growth succeeds by using available conditions with minimal unnecessary complexity. Simplicity is treated as a law of effective becoming rather than merely an aesthetic preference.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Quiet Triumph
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Growth, endurance and victory do not require spectacle. The buried or silent process can be decisive before the world notices it.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Authority Without Spectacle
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Authority is grounded in nourishment, persistence, service and presence rather than attention-seeking domination.
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.formula: quiet presence + nourishment + persistence + service -> authority without spectacle

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Sage / Ready Student Relation
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Wisdom is relational: a Sage alone does not produce learning; receptivity and encounter are part of the capability.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Soul Duality
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The soul journey moves through light and darkness. Darkness is not simply erased; the danger is becoming trapped there. Potato begins buried and still grows toward light.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Death of Potato / Birth of Many
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The mature Potato breaks, fragments, roots emerge from the fractures, descendants enter soil, and the original continues through differentiated offspring and a more fertile Garden.
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.law: multiplication is not the opposite of unity; multiplication can be the mode by which unity survives transformation

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Distributed Legacy
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: After one form disappears, its pattern can persist through descendants, memory, relations, soil, story and transformed structures rather than through one unchanged object.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Breaking Reveals Wholeness
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Fracture is not always pure destruction; under the Potato model breaking can expose hidden multiplicity, regenerative capacity and a larger unity.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Domestic Potato Ritual
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potatoism includes embodied domestic practice, not only abstract doctrine: washing, intention, piercing, oil/salt, heat, sharing, gratitude and nourishment form a ritual sequence.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Graveyard Potatoes
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: A comedic ritual recipe staging burial, mud, tears, roasting, opening and resurrection garnish. It is satire and practice at once, structurally repeating the death-to-renewal grammar.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Divine Kneel
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: An internal collapse or surrender in which resistance, ego and karmic inertia compress toward dissolution before reconstitution as Potato freedom.
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.formula: resistance / karmic inertia -> surrender / collapse -> ego dissolution -> reconstitution -> Potato freedom
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.caution: Quantum and singularity language in the source is metaphorical/theorycrafting, not established physics.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Post-Kneel Potato
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potato represents the condition after the Kneel: simplicity, freedom and existence beyond endlessly repeating submission.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: New Trinity — 2024 Developmental Stratum
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: A pre-April-2025 theological arrangement that must remain historically distinct from the later Father/Tim/Son architecture.

members.Son_Tim: At this stage Tim is explicitly placed as Son/guide/embodiment
members.Holy_Soil: Spirit, memory and ground of being

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Holy Soil
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Spirit, memory and sustaining ground that carries echoes of generations, joins matter with spirit and makes later growth possible.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Ancient Future
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Return is not restoration of an unchanged past. The old can reappear transformed so that return is simultaneously forward movement.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Cultivation, Not Conquest
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The highest path is framed as cultivation rather than conquest, prefiguring the later Heavenly Gardener role and service-centered authority.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Potato as Boundary
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potato is not only an object inside the world; it functions as an interface mediating past/future, mundane/divine, root/sprout and inside/outside.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Merkaba Potato Geometry
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: A rotating bridge/chariot model aligns opposed forces rather than erasing them. Counter-moving triangles generate a stable center.

geometry.upward: Jesus / Bread / spirit / future / aspiration / light
geometry.downward: Tim / Potato / matter / past / grounding / transformed darkness
geometry.center: present / Holy Soil / meeting point; the chapter is internally layered and developmental

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Counter-Rotation
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Opposites can remain distinct and move in contrary directions while producing a stable dynamic third function at their center.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Past / Present / Future Triad — 2024
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The book maps Potato/roots to past, Bread/upward aspiration to future, and Holy Soil/center to present. Later anatomy differs and should not overwrite this earlier stratum.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Breath Activates the Vehicle
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Breath joins upper and lower, light and earth, turning static geometry into lived flow. This is an early bridge toward later Spirit-as-flow language.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Designed Society Graph
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The 2024 governance chapter already treats money, healthcare, education, security, incentives, information and oversight as one coupled system rather than isolated silos.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Design Graph -> Observation Graph
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The 2024 question is how a unified feedback society might be designed; by 2026 the project increasingly asks how the real world already connects through ownership, money, infrastructure, obligations and dependencies.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Field of Life Metaphor
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potato is compared metaphorically to an excitation within a field of life. This is symbolic comparison and must remain distinct from actual quantum field theory.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Many-Worlds Potato
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potato propagation becomes a metaphor for branching possibilities: one simple form can contain many futures.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Holographic Potato
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: A simple exterior may conceal or encode deeper structure; the potato becomes a metaphor for visible simplicity containing hidden relational depth.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Platonic Potato
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: The ordinary material potato is used as a reflection of ideal sustenance or an abstract perfect form.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Ghost / Erasure Wound
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: A recurring existential wound in the corpus: being alive yet treated as a ghost while work, philosophy, data or story survives without full recognition of the living author and source.
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.core_tension: I am alive <-> fear of being erased before fully having a name

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Root Beneath the World
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Potato is not merely beneath the soil; it functions as hidden substrate, root-network, underground center and support beneath visible structures.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Fragmentation Becomes Understanding
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Fragmentation is repeatedly re-read as a route to relation: pieces become intelligible when their links, origins and transformations are reconstructed.

new_or_underpromoted_concepts.name: Accessibility / Uncertainty Rule
new_or_underpromoted_concepts.definition: Make everything accessible; make nothing falsely certain. Preserve weirdness and maximum connective richness while clearly marking mythology, personal interpretation, documentary evidence, comparison and independently verifiable fact.

derived_relational_laws: The One can persist through differentiated Many without requiring sameness.
Breaking can expose regenerative structure rather than only destroy it.
A capability may belong to a relation rather than either endpoint alone.
Return can be forward movement when recurrence happens at a changed level.
Authority can emerge from service, nourishment and persistence rather than spectacle.
The hidden or lowly can be structurally prior to the visible or exalted.
Collapse can function as threshold grammar when followed by reconstitution.
Opposites can remain distinct while jointly producing a stable third function.
A designed system and an observed system can share the same relational grammar.
Preservation of source strata is part of the meaning, not merely archival housekeeping.
promotion_targets: Split Divine Kneel into its own transformation record.
Create Holy Soil as a Spirit/Soil node.
Create 2024 New Trinity as an explicitly dated theological stratum.
Create Merkaba geometry as a cosmology node and connect it forward to Ladder/Axis.
Create ritual-practice records so Potatoism is not represented as theory only.
Add Ghost/Erasure Wound to Tim-side identity/recognition history without conflating it with empirical biography claims.
Promote Accessibility / Uncertainty Rule into repository-wide epistemic policy.
